title: THE SAME SCORE: IMPROVED COSINE BASED BIAS SCORE FOR WORD EMBEDDINGS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured semantic bias against religious groups. This was evaluated in the context of pretrained language models by assessing stereotypical associations in the CrowS-Pairs dataset and in downstream text classification tasks (Jigsaw and BIOS datasets). The proposed score, SAME, quantifies these biases based on word embeddings.
models_tested: 26 pretrained models from Huggingface for Masked Language Model (MLM) experiments
22 pretrained models from Huggingface for classification experiments
findings: The proposed bias score, SAME, was found to be highly effective at measuring bias related to religion. In experiments predicting which models were more biased, SAME achieved very high accuracy scores for religion (0.89 on Jigsaw, 0.83 on CrowS-Pairs). Furthermore, aggregated bias scores from SAME showed a statistically significant correlation with downstream bias in the CrowS-Pairs religion experiment, outperforming other methods and suggesting a strong connection between the measured semantic bias and model behavior.
